config.reference: Frozen piecewise-linear deformed subdivided source mesh, no per-frame normalization
config.freeze: Fixed local full C=(A,g,c), normal unchanged; Q follows displaced center
config.transport: initial full local C=A/g/c, apply diag(J_used^-1,1) congruence and recenter at current v; recompute eigs; n/p/v exactly parent freeze
config.refit: Reference-assisted frozen sample membership, source material sample barycentrics, area-change weights, unit current triangle planes; no relocation
config.shared_initialization: Common reference refit at t=0, checked against shrunk original fit; exactly reused for all arms at t=0
config.interpretation: Controlled deterministic geometry paths. Not material simulation, generated trajectories, feedback corrections, or all-time topology guarantees.
config.guard: Same safe extractor for every arm. Only 64*eps arccos boundary clamp; actual graph capacities checked before mincut. No Q/mesh repair.
config.thresholds: No new RMS quality threshold. Preserve failed geometry and actual face counts.
known_limitations: paired persistent point identities and prescribed motion, not learned/noise-to-shape generation
regularized rank-deficient directions use a prior, not recovered information
independent mapping from initial state, not cumulative motion integration
same archived PL target, bottle reference sensitivity unresolved
no training or matched-cost speed claim

motion_estimator.neighbors: source-space Euclidean, excluding self, frozen across time; kNN ties not permutation-certified; zero kth-neighbor scale is explicit input rejection
motion_estimator.lsq16: weighted SVD, relative singular threshold 1e-6; rank<3 uses identity fallback
motion_estimator.ridge16: lambda=1e-3*trace(X.T W X)/3; identity prior; rank deficiency recorded, not rejected solely for deficiency
motion_estimator.guards: nonfinite J, determinant<=1e-8, condition>1e4 use identity fallback; no oracle replacement or clipping
motion_estimator.information: only initial and current matched input element coordinates; no target surface, current normals, analytical J, or mesh-quality feedback

config.initial_frame: estimate and record J, then reuse canonical initial Q/eigs to avoid floating-point tie changes
